name: Sloth IF
divergenceSummary: Psychologically crushed by endless horrific deaths, Subaru begs Rem to abandon Lugunica and run away together to Kararagi. Rem accepts his desperate plea, and they board a dragon carriage west.
headline: Fugitives in Kararagi
description: Subaru asks Rem to abandon Lugunica and run away together, and she says yes. They start a new life in Kararagi, raising their children Rigel and Spica.

events.name: The Dragon Carriage to the Western Border
events.description: Subaru and Rem board a carriage heading west toward Kararagi, leaving Lugunica to burn as Subaru buries his heroic ideals in exchange for quiet survival.

events.name: Arrival in the Merchant City of Banan
events.description: Under assumed aliases, the two rent a modest cottage on the outskirts, where Rem grows out her hair and Subaru takes up work at a local trade firm.

events.name: The Birth of Rigel
events.description: Rem gives birth to their first child, a blue-haired boy named Rigel who inherits his mother's demon strength and his father's sharp, unruly glare.

events.name: Welcoming Spica & Decades of Domestic Peace
events.description: With the birth of their daughter Spica, Subaru watches his family thrive under golden western sunsets, though the phantom memory of Emilia never truly fades.
